verdict.rationale: Independent production users report that Pydantic AI itself provides `Agent.iter()` and streaming primitives, which can surface intermediate agent steps. The same users say structured events, reconnection and multi-turn history for a UI took a lot of custom glue, and one user reports some models did not stream for months before a fix. First-party docs in the pack only say the agent can run "behind a web frontend" and that the CLI can serve a browser chat. missing for 10: first-party docs on token streaming and event-stream APIs, documented streaming of tool-call/step events to a UI, built-in UI event protocol or transport, consistent streaming across all model providers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream tokens and intermediate agent events (tool calls, steps) to my UI in real time

citations.quote: pydantic-ai gives you Agent.iter() and streaming primitives
The same agent runs everywhere you need it: behind a web frontend
spin up a uvicorn server to chat with your Pydantic AI agents from your browser
